
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(cowplot)
library(emmeans)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)   # gives p-values and easier anova for lmer

here()
dr_here()

pal2 <- c("#015b58", "#5962b5")
pal2.flip <- c("#5962b5", "#015b58")
#inph <- read.csv(here("data/inphared_db/14Apr2025_knownsporestatus.csv", row.names=1))
inph.all <- read.csv(here("00_data", "inphared_db", "14Apr2025_knownsporestatus.csv"), row.names = 1)

inph.all$sporulation <- "T"
inph.all$sporulation <- ifelse(inph.all$f_spor==TRUE, "SproulatingHost", "NonsporulatingHost")

inph.all <- unite(inph.all, "phage_type", c("sporulation", "predicted_label"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE, na.rm = FALSE)



### remove duplicates (keep only reference strains)
### currently this only works on bacilliota, 99.5% ANI over 100% alignment threshold
## rest of inph.allared is pending 

inph.all <- subset(inph.all, inph.all$ref=="not_run" | inph.all$ref=="ref_seq")


inph.all$genome.log <- log10(inph.all$Genome.Length..bp.)
inph.all$cds.log <- log10(inph.all$Number.CDS)



inph<- subset(inph.all, inph.all$newgtdb_Phylum=="Bacillota")


```


```{r}
m_mixed1 <- lmer(
  log(Genome.Length..bp.) ~ log(Number.CDS) * f_spor * lifestyle + 
    (1 | Host),
  data = inph,
  REML = FALSE
)
summary(m_mixed1)

m_mixed2 <- lmer(
  log(Genome.Length..bp.) ~ log(Number.CDS) * f_spor * lifestyle +
    (1 + log(Number.CDS) | Host),
  data = inph,
  REML = FALSE
)
summary(m_mixed2)

isSingular(m_mixed2, tol = 1e-4)

m_mixed2_bobyqa <- update(m_mixed2, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
summary(m_mixed2_bobyqa)


anova(m_mixed1, m_mixed2_bobyqa)   # LRT; both fitted with REML=FALSE
AIC(m_mixed1, m_mixed2_bobyqa)


```


sporulation effect on lifestyle powerlaw
```{r}

slopes_mixed <- emtrends(m_mixed2, ~ f_spor | lifestyle,
                         var = "log(Number.CDS)")
pairs(slopes_mixed)

```
sporulation effect on lifestyle fixed genome size
```{r}
cds_med <- median(inph$Number.CDS)

intercepts_mixed <- emmeans(m_mixed2_bobyqa, 
                            ~ f_spor | lifestyle,
                            at = list(`log(Number.CDS)` = log(cds_med)))
pairs(intercepts_mixed)

library(ggplot2)
emmip(m_mixed2_bobyqa, f_spor ~ Number.CDS | lifestyle,
      at = list(Number.CDS = seq(min(inph$Number.CDS),
                                 max(inph$Number.CDS),
                                 length=200)),
      type="response")
```

```{r}

#install.packages("mclust"); 
library(mclust)
x <- log(subset(inph, lifestyle=="Lytic")$Genome.Length..bp.)
mc <- Mclust(x, G=2)   # try 2 components
table(mc$classification)
# attach cluster assignment and test spor effect within each cluster:
inph$cluster <- NA
inph$cluster[inph$lifestyle=="Lytic"] <- mc$classification
# then run emmeans or mixed model within each cluster:
library(lmerTest)
m_c1 <- lmer(log(Genome.Length..bp.) ~ log(Number.CDS)*f_spor + (1|Host),
             data = subset(inph, lifestyle=="Lytic" & cluster==1))
summary(m_c1)

#install.packages("flexmix"); 
library(flexmix)
fm <- flexmix(log(Genome.Length..bp.) ~ log(Number.CDS) + f_spor,
              data = subset(inph, lifestyle=="Lytic"), k = 2)
parameters(fm)
# examine how f_spor effect differs by component

#install.packages("segmented"); 
library(segmented)
library(segmented)

# fit lm with raw Number.CDS (so Number.CDS exists in model frame)
lm0 <- lm(log(Genome.Length..bp.) ~ I(log(Number.CDS)) * f_spor,
          data = subset(inph, lifestyle == "Lytic"))

# initial guess for the breakpoint on the log scale (use median as starting value)
psi0 <- median(log(subset(inph, lifestyle == "Lytic")$Number.CDS), na.rm = TRUE)

# segmented on the log(Number.CDS) term (psi given)
seg <- segmented(lm0, seg.Z = ~ I(log(inph$Number.CDS)), psi = psi0)
summary(seg)
plot(seg)

```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
host_summ <- inph %>%
  group_by(Host, lifestyle, f_spor) %>%
  summarize(med_genome = median(Genome.Length..bp., na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")

# function to compute test stat (difference in medians) for a subset (e.g., Lytic)
obs_stat <- function(df) {
  med_true  <- median(df$med_genome[df$f_spor==TRUE])
  med_false <- median(df$med_genome[df$f_spor==FALSE])
  return(med_true - med_false)
}

perm_test <- function(df, nperm=5000) {
  obs <- obs_stat(df)
  perms <- replicate(nperm, {
    lab <- sample(df$f_spor)   # shuffle label across hosts
    median(df$med_genome[lab==TRUE]) - median(df$med_genome[lab==FALSE])
  })
  pval <- mean(abs(perms) >= abs(obs))
  list(obs = obs, pval = pval, perms = perms)
}

# run per lifestyle
lyt <- perm_test(filter(host_summ, lifestyle=="Lytic"))
tmp <- perm_test(filter(host_summ, lifestyle=="Temp"))
lyt$obs; lyt$pval
tmp$obs; tmp$pval




```
